report_guidance: Use the document's source-supported title and date. Prefer a prominent heading identifying the report over incidental mentions. Do not infer a title from a footer alone. Distinguish the report's own date from filing, service, and printing dates. Leave unresolved values empty rather than inventing them.
form_guidance: Use the form's source-supported title, preferably its prominent heading. A form need not appear in a practice-specific catalog. Do not infer a title from an incidental reference to another document. Leave an unresolved title empty rather than guessing.
